decisions.reason: The candidate already records the same-message general rule that chapters remain short unless they contain question-and-answer content. The first-time-leader chapter's exemption does not establish that this candidate chapter qualifies for an exemption.

The candidate already records the same-message conditional length rule. The source Requirement's question-and-answer format does not necessarily establish the same format or exemption for this separate chapter.

The AI chapter already carries the same-message rule that it should be short unless presented as question-and-answer content. Exempting the first-time-leader question-and-answer chapter does not alter the AI chapter.
The pre-interview chapter already records both its short checklist format and the general conditional length rule. The separate exemption for a question-and-answer chapter does not change this state.
The source change concerns chapter length, while this Requirement governs which answer layers apply to individual questions. Its current structure remains valid unchanged.
The first-time-leader chapter's length exemption does not change the requirement to include country- and industry-sensitive perspectives.
The source change concerns the length treatment of a new question-and-answer chapter and does not alter review, removal, or finalization of the existing question set.
Allowing one question-and-answer chapter to fall outside the short-only expectation does not modify the separately stated 50,000-word manuscript cap or its planning estimates.
The chapter-length decision is unrelated to the completed pre-project writing test and does not change its deliverables or timing.
